this_is_a_DATA_file: ⚠️ NO RULES, NO PROSE ESSAYS, NO BYTE COUNTS, NO NUMERIC PLATFORM IDs. Every rule that used to be written out here now lives in its gate, which is where it is enforced (Constitution §2). Pointers: class = PERSISTENCE not rank → _shared/super-agent-base.md §6 · naming, tokens, homophones, post-rename slug check → gates/agent-name-collision-gate.md · default_runbook, gate_strength, earn-auto-don't-assume-it, the three equivalent doors → gates/agent-invocation-gate.md · how to build/graduate → gates/git-teammate-lifecycle-runbook.md. Trim prose, never split the list.
size_escalation: Target ~12KB has NEVER been met. At ~22KB on disk this file cannot be read whole (base64 inflates 4/3 past the ~30KB return cap) and therefore cannot be safely edited — and this file IS the registration path. FOR MICHAEL/DEXTER: pick a target we will actually hold, or drop `accent` (32 rows, already has duplicate values across rows, so it is not a reliable identifier anyway — it is the fattest remaining non-essential and roster.html would need one edit).
